title: Computational insights into phthalimide-core non-fullerene acceptors for next-generation organic solar cells
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,31019-31031
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04527D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Zunaira Khan, Hussain J. Alathlawi, Karrar Hazim Salem, Syed Muhammad Kazim Abbas Naqvi, Ines Hilali Jaghdam, Mohamed S. Soliman, Tamer H. A. Hasanin, Sajjad Ali, Haq Nawaz Bhatti, Rasheed Ahmad Khera
Seven phthalimide-based nonfullerene acceptors are designed by DFT. They show redshifted absorption, improved charge mobility, and reduced exciton binding energies, offering a pathway to efficient, low-cost, scalable OSCs.
